question_text: Was Vermont's Valcour police dispatch outage a cyberattack?
answer_text: The vendor reported a potential security incident and the state calls it a security incident, but no official has said an attacker got in, what was hit, or who did it. The FBI has been notified.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A state, vendor or FBI statement saying what happened, or a published root cause.

question_text: Is the Valcour outage connected to the national outages this week?
answer_text: Vermont's IT chief said there is no evidence of a link. The governor said there are 'too many points of coincidence' but is waiting on the investigation. No cause has been published.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A published cause for Valcour, or investigators naming a link or ruling one out.

question_text: Can I still call 911 in Vermont?
answer_text: Yes. The state says 911, emergency response and non-emergency department lines all work. Police and fire are using backup procedures, so some paperwork is slower.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Was police or personal data stolen in the Valcour incident?
answer_text: No statement says whether any data was accessed or taken. The state says the nature and scope are still being investigated.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A state or vendor statement on data access, or breach notices.

question_text: When will Valcour be back online?
answer_text: The state says it stays offline until the investigation is done and any weaknesses are fixed, and it has no timeline yet.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A state announcement of a restore date.
